comments.text: T9 merged (PR 542) and deployed to development; verified live 2026-10-13. Shipped: Costs tab in the inspector (Context | Files | Costs); header cost chip for the open conversation; Triggered/Took markers under messages; organization month summary with breakdowns by bot, conversation and model; recent turns with Show more; per-turn drill-down with per-call model, tokens, cache reads/writes, tier, price book and dollars; CSV export (turn and call grain); incomplete totals shown as 'at least $x ... incomplete: N unpriced calls', unpriced calls never shown as zero; estimated/gateway/voice rows labelled; sub-cent money precision; standing 'not a bill' basis line. Signed-in Costs tab opened on develop.chattic.us and shows its empty state correctly for an organization with no new-format records. NOT verified: the populated view with real data in the signed-in workspace (fixtures only, desktop and 375 px, light and dark), and the header chip and message markers in the live thread; a follow-up ticket tracks it. Not built: compare UI and export polish (chatticus-dffe56), per-sub-agent cost (chatticus-24308d), legacy ledger migration (chatticus-0d265c), compaction cost beyond T5 caveats. Rates are from the pi-ai bundled catalog, not verified against the vendor page.
